summary: Adagio Medical Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 27, 2026, announcing positive pivotal trial results for its vCLAS Ventricular Ablation System via a press release. The FULCRUM-VT IDE study met safety and effectiveness endpoints, with 84% freedom from ICD shock and 59% freedom from VT recurrence at six months. The announcement is a routine operational update on clinical trial outcomes, not a special situation. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital event is disclosed. This filing constitutes a standard current report on other events.
